## v1.8.12 — Post-reboot telemetry UX

### Fixed

- **Agent** — LXC/Docker container lists are no longer wiped when the Proxmox or Docker API is briefly unreachable; last-known cache is kept until a successful fetch
- **Dashboard** — app cards stay on **CHECKING...** instead of premature **UNKNOWN** while waiting for Proxmox/agent data (service worker v47)
- **URL health** — requires two consecutive failures before marking an app **OFFLINE** (first success still goes **ONLINE** immediately)

### Docs

- FAQ and troubleshooting notes for the post-reboot wait window (host metrics first, then LXC badges)

### Upgrade

```bash
./update-amud.sh
```

Hard-refresh once after update so the dashboard script and service worker reload.

**Recommended:** `v1.8.12`
